missionPremise: WDLL item 1 (S1): special-district (mud-pid) on gold inspect reads special-district-fact, not a bake table. Cortex card filed ROOT sibling specialDistrictFact (LDT 451, undeployed). This card is the PE copy onto inspect. Implement against fixtures. Do not invent a MUD. Item 13: no --apply. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-21_serve-pe_dispatch.md; _inbox/2026-08-21_serve_close.json; hauska-map PR 176 landUseFact copy at 3ea9852.
completionPredicate: mergeBakedBaseFacts copies a fixture specialDistrictFact from the cortex JSON ROOT onto the atom-chain payload and does not copy bake / CAD / mud-pid onto that field. A missing field stays missing. Early return with no facets still attaches the root field. Inspect shows Special district when state=present (districtType + name). Typed state=absent stays visible as honest absence and does not render a district name. Gold-shaped :sd:outside fixture does not paint a MUD. Present fixture 48021:102817 shows The Colony MUD 1C. Dual grammar is parcel prefix only (alias retry). Prefer the cortex field; do not re-parse the store. mud-pid live:true only if inspect is wired AND the GIS layer has a source; otherwise leave false. Diff uncommitted. No deploy.
scopeBasis: PE BFF copy plus inspect Special district row. Cortex owns the atom read (LDT 451). Live inspect is atom-chain-warm so mergeBakedBaseFacts is the live path. Do not adopt bake / CAD / mud-pid as specialDistrictFact. Do not invent a MUD on gold 48021:34137. Do not start P-49. Do not flip texas-rrc. Do not occupy P:/hauska-map or the property seat checkout. ParcelFactSheet stays frozen on required fields; specialDistrict is additive optional so stubs do not break.

fieldContract.name: specialDistrictFact
fieldContract.placement: JSON ROOT sibling of facets / tier2 / floodHazardFact / landUseFact, copied root-to-root onto PeBakedFacetsResponse
fieldContract.typeGuard: plain object whose state is present | absent | refused. Reject null, strings, arrays, and bake {districtType, districtName} objects parked on the root with no state.

present.districtType: from cortex body only; never invented
present.districtName: from cortex body only; never invented

absent.row: visible honest absence; no district name

fieldContract.whenMissing: leave the key absent; do not invent a MUD; do not copy bake / CAD / mud-pid onto specialDistrictFact
fieldContract.earlyReturn: if facets are missing, still attach root specialDistrictFact when present
fieldContract.gold: 48021:34137 fixture state=absent entityId 48021:34137:sd:outside. Do not paint a MUD.
fieldContract.presentSubstitute: 48021:102817 The Colony MUD 1C. Dual grammar on the parcel prefix.
fieldContract.entityId: Prefer the cortex field. Do not re-parse the store. Accept :sd:outside (live) and exact :sd (IDENT next apply) only if a client parser of entity_id is touched; this card does not add a parser.

design.livePath: PROPERTY_ATOM_PATH=1 → fetchAtomChainWithAlias + fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias + mergeBakedBaseFacts(adapted, cortexBody) + echoRequestedParcelNodeId. Cortex-off strip already spreads the root.

alias.rule: fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when floodHazardFact OR landUseFact OR specialDistrictFact is missing on a 2xx (or on 404). Return alias only when it fills a root-fact gap.
alias.whyOr: After PR 176, padded gold already carries floodHazardFact and landUseFact. A flood/land-use-only retry never fetches integer specialDistrictFact.

resolver.whenPresent: sheet.specialDistrict from districtType + districtName; provenance.source = special-district-fact
resolver.whenRefused: unresolved with named code; row stays visible
resolver.whenTypedAbsence: absent-covered with absence.reason/kind; row stays visible; no district name
resolver.whenFieldMissing: optional field omitted; card facet unknown so FactRow hides it (same as missing floodHazardFact)

card.label: Special district
card.present: districtType — districtName (or name alone, or type alone)

mudPidLayer.reason: layer-registry emptyBasis is 'No source wired in map-renderer — no live fetch and no fixture. Turning this on draws nothing anywhere.' Inspect can be wired from specialDistrictFact. The GIS layer still has no source, so both cannot be proved. Flipping live would also paint independently of the atom and could contradict gold :sd:outside.

threeQuestionGate.control: vitest on mergeBakedBaseFacts specialDistrictFact copy + resolver + inspect row + cortex alias
threeQuestionGate.whatExecutesIt: pnpm test of the named files under apps/property-explorer (vitest run)
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggersIt: local this lane; planner PR CI after review
threeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenViolated: test fail if merge copies bake onto specialDistrictFact, invents a MUD on a missing field or gold absent fixture, drops a root fact on the no-facets early return, resolver claims a district name from bake, gold absent renders a district name, present fixture does not show MUD 1C, or padded missing specialDistrictFact does not alias integer root
threeQuestionGate.whatBypassesIt: undeployed LDT 451 (field absent on live GET until cortex serves specialDistrictFact AND this PE diff is committed/deployed). mud-pid GIS layer stays live:false.

mergeCopiesRootFact.expect: merged.specialDistrictFact === present fixture (state=present districtType=MUD districtName=The Colony MUD 1C source=special-district-fact)
mergeCopiesRootFact.falsifier: field absent after merge, or a value whose source is bake/CAD/mud-pid

mergeDoesNotCopyBake.expect: 'specialDistrictFact' not in merged when only bake / CAD / mud-pid fields are present
mergeDoesNotCopyBake.falsifier: any specialDistrictFact whose type/name came from bake

goldAbsentNoMud.expect: gold-shaped absent fixture state=absent renders no district name and no MUD
goldAbsentNoMud.falsifier: districtType MUD or districtName painted on gold

presentShowsMud1c.expect: present fixture shows The Colony MUD 1C
presentShowsMud1c.falsifier: name absent, or a different invented name

earlyReturnStillAttaches.expect: mergeBakedBaseFacts(adapted, { specialDistrictFact: fixture }) attaches the fact even with no facets key
earlyReturnStillAttaches.falsifier: returns adapted unchanged (same reference or missing field)

aliasPaddedMissingSpecialDistrictFact.expect: padded cortex missing specialDistrictFact (even if flood and landUse are already present) aliases integer root; echo REQUESTED parcelNodeId
aliasPaddedMissingSpecialDistrictFact.falsifier: specialDistrictFact absent on padded inspect payload while integer fixture carried it

whatIWillViolateToProveTests.violation: temporarily make withSpecialDistrictFact copy a bake district onto specialDistrictFact
whatIWillViolateToProveTests.expectedFail: does not copy bake onto specialDistrictFact

whatIWillViolateToProveTests.violation: temporarily skip specialDistrictFact alias so fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias only retries on missing flood/landUse
whatIWillViolateToProveTests.expectedFail: padded cortex missing specialDistrictFact aliases integer root even when floodHazardFact and landUseFact are already on the padded body

adversarialReview.objection: Rename a bake district field to specialDistrictFact and call that the atom.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch forbids adopting bake / CAD / mud-pid as that field. Cortex LDT 451 writes a ROOT sibling from special-district-fact atoms. Copying the bake would look like a merge win while remaining starved of the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: ROOT only. Type guard requires state present|absent|refused.

adversarialReview.objection: Paint The Colony MUD 1C on gold 48021:34137 because that is the present fixture.
adversarialReview.response: Gold live bind is :sd:outside (typed absence). Present payload is 48021:102817. Painting a MUD on gold is the defect the dispatch names.
adversarialReview.disposition: Fail closed. Gold absent fixture must not render a district name.

adversarialReview.objection: Flip mud-pid live:true because inspect is about to be wired.
adversarialReview.response: Registry emptyBasis says the GIS layer has no source. Inspect from the atom and GIS paint are different surfaces. Gold :sd:outside would be contradicted by a GIS overlay that paints independently.
adversarialReview.disposition: Leave live:false. Say so in the close.

adversarialReview.objection: Add a PE parser of entity_id :sd: tokens so IDENT exact :sd works before cortex deploy.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch: prefer the cortex field; do not re-parse the store. Cortex already accepts :sd:outside and exact :sd. PE copies the interpreted field.

secondMechanism.claim: Atom-chain already carries special-district-fact in chain.atoms so merge is unnecessary.
secondMechanism.rejectedBecause: adaptAtomChainToBakedFacets does not surface that family. Live inspect shows cortex-root facts via mergeBakedBaseFacts (flood PR 175, landUse PR 176). LDT 451 puts specialDistrictFact on the cortex JSON ROOT, which is the copy pattern this card is ordered to follow.
